name: 2-hexyl-1-decanol
description: 2-Hexyl-1-decanol (CAS 2425-77-6 ), commercially available as Guerbitol 16 and Isofol 16, is a branched-chain fatty alcohol used across lubricant, polymer, and personal care manufacturing. Its branched structure resists crystallization at low temperatures, making it a reliable base material where linear alcohols would solidify and disrupt processing during industrial applications. In lubricant and metalworking formulations, it functions as a base fluid component and lubricity additive in synthetic esters and cutting fluids. It provides excellent thermal stability and performance. Plastics processors use it as a plasticizer and processing aid in PVC and other polymer systems, improving flexibility and workability without the volatility concerns associated with shorter-chain alcohols. In personal care, it acts as an emollient carrier and co-emulsifier in creams, lotions, and color cosmetics, contributing to skin feel and formulation stability for high-end consumer products. It also serves as a solvent and carrier for active ingredients in industrial and specialty chemical formulations where low polarity and good solvency are required for effective chemical delivery. 2-Hexyl-1-decanol is supplied as a clear liquid. It is available in technical grade for industrial lubricant and polymer applications, with cosmetic-grade material meeting high purity standards. Bulk supply is standard in drums and IBC containers to meet the needs of large-scale manufacturing. Our material ensures consistent quality and performance across all specified industrial sectors.
